title: A local worker or join failure in the post-reply authority check fences the federation link
outcome: After a verified reply, the sender's authority classification separates a confirmed authority or incarnation mismatch, which fences or returns a typed stale refusal, from a local execution failure. A failed blocking job or join, such as run_blocking_api's local 500, is a request-local UNKNOWN and never fences. NativeBinding keeps its typed stale-authority refusal, but cannot swallow a confirmed mismatch that must fence.
acceptance: In the authenticated RPC sender's post-reply authority step, a local failure of the blocking authority job (a worker or join failure, a local 5xx from run_blocking_api) ends that request as UNKNOWN. The link and the incarnation stay. A confirmed authority or incarnation mismatch still fences as today. Shown by behavioural tests: a prompt-policy request whose authority job fails locally keeps the link and the same pair serves the next request; a real authority change still fences.

For NativeBinding, an ensure_current failure that is a confirmed authority mismatch while the matching incarnation is still installed takes the fence path, or an explicitly ruled equivalent. A local or stale-lease refusal keeps the typed stale-authority refusal. Shown by a behavioural test.
No timeout or limit value changes. The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
